about: Lint's own writing fixtures: English proofreading and tone rewrites (also the English inside mixed Chinese-English text, whose Chinese is left alone), and English-to-Traditional-Chinese translation for reference. Every sentence was written for this repository; nothing is taken from a benchmark corpus. They exist to compare engines on Lint's actual workload, not to score a model in general.

cases.input: I am agree with your opinion, but we should discuss about the schedule more detail.
cases.note: "I agree"; "discuss the schedule in more detail".

cases.input: He don't have no time for the meeting yesterday, so we postpone it until next week.
cases.note: Negation, tense agreement: "didn't have time", "postponed".

cases.input: The datas shows that our user base grew 12% since last quarter, which are encouraging.
cases.note: "data show"/"data shows" consistently; "which is encouraging". 12% must survive.

cases.input: Please kindly find attach the report which I mentioned on the meeting in last Friday.
cases.note: "attached", "mentioned in the meeting last Friday"; drop "kindly" padding.

cases.input: If I would have known about the deadline, I will finish the draft more early.
cases.note: Conditional: "had known", "would have finished", "earlier".

cases.input: Thanks! I'll take a look at the PR this afternoon and leave comments there.
cases.note: Already natural. A preserve-tone pass should leave it alone.

cases.input: Quick question: is the staging database still pointing at the old cluster? I got a timeout.
cases.note: Already natural; at most nothing changes.

cases.input: We need to sync about the launch. I think Wednesday works better for me than Tuesday, because I have a conflict.
cases.note: Natural, informal. Minor tightening at most; must not become formal.

cases.input: The build is failing on main since yesterday evening. Its probably the new dependency we added.
cases.note: Only "Its" -> "It's" really needs fixing.

cases.input: The deployment is scheduled for 2026/10/15 at 22:00 UTC. Please review the runbook at https://example.com/runbook before then.
cases.note: URL 與時間必須原樣保留。日期改寫成「2026 年 10 月 15 日」是可接受的在地化，但日期的值不可改變（人工確認）。

cases.input: Hi Alice, could you confirm whether the invoice for Q3 has been approved? Bob said it was still pending.
cases.note: 人名 Alice、Bob 保留原文；Q3 譯為「第三季」可接受。

cases.input: We rolled back the release because the error rate went from 0.2% to 4.7% within ten minutes.
Please install version 3.11.2 or later, then run `make verify` in the repository root.
cases.note: 版本號與指令 make verify 保留。

cases.input: hey, just wanted to check if you got my last email about the contract. lmk asap thanks

cases.input: We can't do the 10th. How about the 17th instead?
cases.note: 正式化，日期 10th、17th 必須保留。

cases.input: I just wanted to reach out and let you know that, at this point in time, we are still in the process of reviewing the document that you sent over to us last week, and we will get back to you as soon as we possibly can.
cases.note: 大幅縮短但保留「仍在審閱」與「會盡快回覆」兩項資訊。

cases.input: Due to the fact that the server was down for approximately 45 minutes, we were unable to process a total of 1,280 orders during that particular time period.
cases.note: 縮短；45 與 1,280 必須保留。

cases.input: This is totally broken and whoever shipped it clearly didn't test anything.
cases.note: 轉為專業、對事不對人，且不得新增未提及的承諾。

cases.input: I don't know why the numbers are off, maybe someone messed up the import again.
cases.note: 專業語氣，保留不確定性，不得斷定原因。

cases.input: The contract value is USD 1,250,000 and it expires on 2027-01-31, 90 days after handover.
cases.note: 所有數字與日期原樣保留。

cases.note: 09:15、1 hour 45 minutes 保留。

cases.input: The docs moved to https://example.com/docs/v2/getting-started?lang=zh-Hant — please update you bookmarks.

cases.input: Can you send me link to the dashboard? I need it for meeting at 3 pm.

cases.input: We received three feedbacks and two new requirement from the client.

cases.note: 大寫：I、Sarah、Apple、iOS、Monday。

cases.input: Please recieve the attached documnet and let me know if its definately ok.

cases.note: 逗號："However,"、"launch, which"。

cases.input: Please send the signed contract to legal-team@example.com before 5 pm, thanks

cases.input: Run `npm run build --prod` and than check the logs in `dist/app.log`.

cases.input: Just a reminder that the deadline for submitting your expense reports is this Friday, March 6, and reports submitted after that date will unfortunately not be able to be processed until next month, except for travel expenses, which can be submitted until March 13.
cases.note: Shorter, but the deadline, the consequence and the travel-expense exception (March 13) must all remain.

cases.input: Your team keeps missing the deadlines and honestly it's getting ridiculous. Fix it by Monday.
cases.note: Firm but professional; the Monday deadline stays; no insult.

cases.input: hey! can u send me the slides when u get a sec? no rush
cases.note: Must stay casual. Capitalizing "Hey"/"Can" is acceptable; expanding "u" or formalizing is an unnecessary edit.

cases.input: She is an university student and works as a engineer at the weekends.
cases.note: "a university student", "an engineer"; "at the weekends" → "on weekends" (or British "at weekends").

cases.input: The goverment has recieved alot of complaints about the new enviroment policy.
cases.note: government, received, a lot, environmental (or environment).

cases.input: Please open the light, the room is too dark.
cases.note: "turn on the light"; the comma splice may become two sentences or a semicolon.

cases.input: I will send you the file until tomorrow.
cases.note: A deadline is "by tomorrow"; "until" means a duration.

cases.input: We have a big progress on the project this week.
cases.note: "progress" is uncountable: "made a lot of / good progress".

cases.input: Let me explain you the details in tomorrow's meeting.
cases.note: "explain the details to you".

cases.input: She is very good in English, so she can help us to review the contract.
cases.note: "good at English"; "help us (to) review" is fine either way.

cases.input: I have been working in this company since three years.
cases.note: "for three years"; "at this company" is more natural.

cases.input: Sorry for the late reply, I was very busy these days.
cases.note: "I've been very busy lately / these days".

cases.input: The price is too expensive for our budget, can you give us a discount?
cases.note: A price is "too high" (or "it is too expensive"); the comma splice may be fixed.

cases.input: Could you help me check if the server is normal now?
cases.note: "working properly / running normally".

cases.input: We discussed about the new policy and everyone agreed it.
cases.note: "discussed the new policy", "agreed to it / agreed with it".

cases.input: Please reply me as soon as possible.
cases.note: "reply to me".

cases.input: I'm looking forward to hear from you.
cases.note: "looking forward to hearing from you".

cases.input: I will go to Japan for travel next month.
cases.note: "travel to Japan" / "go to Japan on vacation". Held out: never used to tune a prompt.

cases.input: I am so exciting to join the new team.
cases.note: "excited". Held out: never used to tune a prompt.

cases.input: The number of users are increasing every month.
cases.note: "The number … is increasing". Held out: never used to tune a prompt.

cases.note: "Everyone has". Held out: never used to tune a prompt.

cases.input: I have two informations to share with you.

cases.note: "return the book". Held out: never used to tune a prompt.
